info.title: FOOD physical replenishment and MAIN source admission
info.description: Simple business stock remains independent. All cumulative quantities are local frozen base units, never deltas. Preserve original request parameters (including BigDecimal representation) under a repeated key. Source line identity excludes connection generation. ACK is the committed queryable local receipt, not a claim of additional source push acknowledgment. Return-ack only verifies source actual receipt, does not mean source available stock/clearance. Stable source instance must be configured by shop.inventory.replenishment.source-system; no activation, source posting, automatic sync or writer switch is performed. I04-C: OFF stops unfamiliar new originals while accepted ones finish; generation excludes logistics dedupe. Stable source identity cannot be switched by reconnect. Local 17 stays 17. Actual source late low-sequence originals use manual evidence only. A CANCELLED original is a permanent source-action/key tombstone, preventing late execution without reversing committed effects. Remote client transport no longer requires embedded inventory feature. Existing mirror DISABLING/DEACTIVATE/OFF barrier remains independent. D2-01/02: MAIN owns one immutable source-line claim across FOOD and retail. Host commits the claim before signed FOOD registration; EXTERNAL is an intent, not a FOOD stock receipt. Existing FOOD originals are queried including archived source identities; missing history transport is not absence. Old internal registration recovers existing sources only. Deploy that FOOD gate before the new host; no mixed unregistered writers may use the host signing credential. Retail registration remains internal PENDING only: no retail public API, quantity writer or App is enabled.

quantity.description: Exact BigDecimal from actual posted source fact; never an App-chosen balance.

StockSourceClaim.description: Trusted-host attestation inside the existing full-body signature. Only produced after durable MAIN claim; not a public bearer token or permission. Binding uses REPLENISH_SOURCE_V1 canonical source/mapping/scope, not posting sequence.

FoodSourceLookup.description: Outer protocol response must exist. A null result means no source original; transport failure must never be mapped to null.

FoodRegistrationRecovery.description: Existing recovery contract extended compatibly: absent movementNo selects normal REGISTER; non-null original movementNo selects MANUAL_REGISTER. Actor/action/doc/line/mapping/movement must match the stored original snapshot, including old source JSON without postingSequence. A sealed key is rejected before source RPC or MAIN source claim.

x-internal-food-transport.authentication: Existing InternalHttp FOOD token + signed full body and entity/store/actorNo scope. No direct App access.

x-retail-local-effects.publication: Internal Java service only; no retail HTTP/App paths published in D2-03. D2-04 will publish authorized ai-shop endpoints.
x-retail-local-effects.transactions: Existing PLATFORM counters + effect + original cumulative totals + permanent successful command receipt commit atomically. Source RPC precedes transaction.
x-retail-local-effects.replay: Original raw request key, actor and stable payload digest; existing completed reply wins before current state validation. Same key with another payload conflicts.
x-retail-local-effects.receipt: receive and dispatchReturn take integer cumulative targets and apply only delta. ackReturn and adoptManual never change local counters.
x-retail-local-effects.sourceReturn: Verified source RETURN must reference SRP original; exact frozen conversion, globally unique source line.
x-retail-local-effects.manual: Only real ADJUST_IN movement with matching successful command, scope and frozen target; one whole movement belongs to one original.
x-retail-local-effects.reconciliation: Read-only evidence totals; never infer whole current stock from one replenishment or repair discrepancies.
x-retail-local-effects.legacyFence: REPLENISH forbids old absolute setters, unsupported existing SKU unit/market/retirement/pool changes; metadata edits preserve actual counters.
